data.title: 朝武芳乃 · 鸟居倒影下的神女涉足
data.action: 赤足踩在漫过脚踝的温润潮水中，双手合拢护在胸前，乌黑长发梳成优雅神职发髻，晨雾中带着一丝神圣与清纯的羞涩，回身迎上对方的目光
data.location: 涨潮时半浸入海水的朱红色海上鸟居之下
data.lighting: 破晓时分紫粉色朝霞漫射，水面如镜倒映鸟居与身影
data.camera: 庄重对称中景，朱红鸟居框架住宁静海面与神圣少女
data.mood: 神圣清丽、温婉含羞、和风雅致
data.description: 破晓潮平的海上鸟居圣域。朝武芳乃身着穗织神子紫藤印花和风裹身泳装，涉步于镜面般的浅波之中。朝霞如紫雾般笼罩海天，她双手端庄拢于胸前，微红着脸回头看向陪伴在侧的你，神职巫女的高洁端丽与少女初露心扉的娇羞融为一体。
promptTokens: pale wisteria lavender and white wrap bikini
falling cherry blossom and wisteria prints
standing barefoot in ankle-deep sea reflecting sky
sacred red torii gate rising from ocean behind
hands folded respectfully in front of chest
data.promptProse: Yoshino Tomotake wading barefoot within the mirror-calm shallows under a majestic vermilion torii gate standing in the sea at dawn. She wears an exquisite pale wisteria-purple wrap bikini adorned with floating floral motifs and tied with clean white silk sashes. With her glossy black hair held by a priestess ornament, she clasps her hands demurely over her chest with a saintly yet tenderly blushing expression.
